# Visual inspection

Exactly three built-in image_gen calls, run in parallel. Original generated PNGs copied here unchanged. Output size is 1672 × 941 pixels, approximately 16:9 (requested 2048 × 1152 was not honored by the tool).

- scene-story.png: Three people in a credible conversation, usable pale right/bottom-right space. Ring is worn on the index finger but is too small to verify the exact oval button, and the band appears simplified. A tiny ear stud appears on the left person despite the no-other-jewelry instruction. Physical paper contains ring sketches despite the prompt asking for no graphic elements.
- poetic-problem.png: Strongest visible fidelity to the reference ring: similar broad polished band, seam, elongated oval button, and three-quarter orientation. This is visual similarity, not CAD accuracy. The notebook contains product sketches and circular construction marks rather than only unfinished notes. Grid and generous right-side space work well. Shadow is ambiguous between chair/window.
- hybrid.png: Credible person and tabletop, large usable right-side space, ring visible on index finger. Oval button appears smaller/more rectangular and band details are simplified relative to reference. Top of hair is cropped. Paper contains circular product sketches despite the request to avoid curves and diagrams.

All outputs have no legible headline, logo, watermark, wave, or connector overlay. Physical sketches include curves. Product fidelity is not exact or guaranteed; the still-life is the closest of the three.
